dev.description: Watch mode: rebuild CSS and restart the Deno server on changes

dev:css.description: Rebuild public/styles.css whenever the HTML, JS or CSS entry changes

dev:server.description: Run the Deno adapter, restarting on source changes

start.description: Build CSS once, then run the Deno adapter

build:css.description: Compile frontend/styles.css with the Tailwind CLI into public/styles.css

test.description: Run the core tests (no permissions: the app does no I/O of its own)

check.description: Type-check the server, all four adapters, the tests and the frontend JS
check.command: deno check src/ tests/ public/app.js public/lib.js
